# Taxonomic resolution for the Oʻahu community

```{r taxonomy_resolution}
b_taxonomy_df <- taxonomy_df |>
  # Treat unresolved names consistently with the original analysis.
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      .cols = c("species","genus","family", "order"),
      .fns = ~ dplyr::na_if(., "Nan")
    )
  ) |>
  # Treat provisional names as unresolved.
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      .cols = c("species","genus","family"),
      .fns = ~ dplyr::case_when(
        stringr::str_detect(., regex("\\bsp\\b|\\bsp\\.\\b|\\bcf\\b|\\bcf\\.\\b|\\bspp\\b|\\bspp\\.\\b", ignore_case = TRUE)) ~ NA_character_,
        TRUE ~ .
      )
    )
  ) |>
dplyr::mutate(
    res_rank = dplyr::case_when(
      perc_id >= 99 ~ "species",
      perc_id >= 97 & perc_id < 99 ~ "genus",
      perc_id >= 93 & perc_id < 97 ~ "family",
      TRUE ~ "higher_or_none"),
     res_rank = factor(res_rank, levels = c("species","genus","family","higher_or_none"))
   ) |>
  # Standardize ASV identifiers.
  dplyr::mutate(
    zotu_id = stringr::str_to_lower(zotu_id)
  )

# Join `meta_oahu` and `zotu_df` to keep only Oʻahu ASVs.
# First pivot longer, then join retained ASVs.

taxonomy_oahu <- zotu_df |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = dplyr::starts_with("zotu"),
    names_to = "zotu_id",
    values_to = "abundance"
  ) |>
  dplyr::inner_join(meta_oahu, by = "sample_id") |>
  dplyr::select(sample_id, zotu_id, abundance) |>
  dplyr::inner_join(b_taxonomy_df, by = "zotu_id") |>
  dplyr::select(-sample_id, -sample_id, -abundance) |>
  dplyr::distinct()
```

# Table 1: status assignments by method

```{r status_summary}
# Load invasive status predictions from NIClassify + BLAST mapping
status <- read.csv(here::here("NIClassify/06_NIClassify_predict.csv")) |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  dplyr::rename(zotu_id = upid) |>
  filter(str_detect(zotu_id, "Zotu")) |>
  select(zotu_id, status_final = final_status, status_ni = predict)

# Load BLAST/IBIS predictions from Excel (manual curation)
status_blast <- read.xlsx(data_path("tax_invasive.xlsx"), sheet = "taxonomy")  |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  select(zotu_id, status_genus) |>
  rename(status_blast = status_genus)

#Load BOLD predictions from Excel (manual curation)
status_bold <- read.xlsx(data_path("tax_invasive.xlsx"), sheet = "taxonomy_bold") |>
  mutate(
    zotu_id = stringr::str_to_lower(id),.before = "id"
  ) |>
  select(zotu_id, status_bold = status_genus) |>
  #unknown needs to be NA in stauts_bold
  mutate(
    status_bold = ifelse(status_bold == "unknown", NA_character_, status_bold)
  )


# Combine and clean all invasion status sources
status_comb <- status |>
  left_join(status_blast, by = "zotu_id") |>
  dplyr::rename(ibis_status = status_final) |>
  # Convert blank strings to NA
  mutate(across(c(ibis_status, status_ni, status_blast),
                ~ ifelse(.x == "", NA_character_, .x))) |>
    mutate(
    zotu_id = stringr::str_to_lower(zotu_id)
  ) |>
  left_join(status_bold, by = "zotu_id") |>
  # Normalize case and rename columns for clarity
  mutate(
    Ibis      = tolower(ibis_status),
    NiClassify= tolower(status_ni),
    BOLD      = tolower(status_bold),
    NCBI     = tolower(status_blast),
    zotu_id   = tolower(zotu_id)

  ) |>
  select(-contains("status"))  # drop original status columns

summary_stats <- status_comb |>
  #calculate % introduces vs native vs NA for each method
  #first pivot longer
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Ibis, NiClassify, NCBI, BOLD),
               names_to = "method", values_to = "status") |>
  mutate(
    method = dplyr::recode(
      method,
      "NiClassify" = "NIClassify",
      "Ibis" = "IBIS"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(status = dplyr::if_else(status == "unknown", NA_character_, status)) |>
  group_by(method, status) |>
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  #pivot wider for nicer table
  pivot_wider(names_from = status, values_from = count, values_fill = 0) |>
  dplyr::rename("No information available" = "NA")


# Use gt to export a publication-ready summary table
summary_stats |>
  gt() |>
  tab_header(title = "Summary of Invasive Status Predictions") |>
  cols_label(method = "Prediction Method") |>
  fmt_number(columns = everything(), decimals = 0) |>
  cols_width(everything() ~ px(150)) |>
  tab_spanner(
    label = "Invasive Status",
    columns = c("introduced", "native", "No information available")
  ) |>
  tab_source_note(
    source_note = "Data obtained through Ibis geolocation API, BLAST mapping paired species lookup &  NIClassify predictions"
  )

# Export Table 1.
date_stamp <- format(Sys.Date(), "%Y_%m_%d")

gtsave(
  summary_stats |>
    gt() |>
    tab_header(title = "Summary of Invasive Status Predictions") |>
    cols_label(method = "Prediction Method") |>
    fmt_number(columns = everything(), decimals = 0) |>
    cols_width(everything() ~ px(150)) |>
    tab_spanner(
      label = "Invasive Status",
      columns = c("introduced", "native", "No information available")
    ) |>
    tab_source_note(
      source_note = "Data obtained through Ibis geolocation API, BLAST mapping paired species lookup &  NIClassify predictions"
    ),
  filename = file.path(out_fig_main, paste0("T1_", date_stamp, "_invasive_status_summary_table.png"))
)
```

# Figure S1: NIClassify prediction comparison

```{r niclassify_prediction_comparison}
cv_df <- readr::read_csv(here::here("NIClassify/06_NIClassify_predict.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  transmute(
    true_label = stringr::str_to_lower(final_status),
    pred_label = stringr::str_to_lower(predict)
  ) |>
  filter(
    true_label %in% c("introduced", "native"),
    pred_label %in% c("introduced", "native")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    true_label = factor(true_label, levels = c("introduced", "native")),
    pred_label = factor(pred_label, levels = c("introduced", "native"))
  )

cv_conf <- cv_df |>
  count(true_label, pred_label, name = "n") |>
  group_by(true_label) |>
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) |>
  ungroup()

s1_cv_plot <- ggplot(cv_conf, aes(x = pred_label, y = true_label, fill = prop)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", prop)), color = "#f0d400", size = 6) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "viridis", limits = c(0, 1), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Predicted label", y = "True label") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

save_fig(
  tag = "S1_niclassify_cross_validation_confusion",
  plot = s1_cv_plot,
  which = "supp",
  prefix = "none",
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 400
)
```

# Figure 2: taxonomic resolution and status

```{r sankey_setup}
rank_levels <- c("Species-level", "Genus-level", "Family-level", "Order-or-higher")

sankey_taxonomy_df <- taxonomy_oahu |>
  mutate(
    res_rank = recode(
      res_rank,
      "species" = "Species-level",
      "genus" = "Genus-level",
      "family" = "Family-level",
      "higher_or_none" = "Order-or-higher"
    ),
    res_rank = factor(res_rank, levels = rank_levels)
  )

materialize_nodes_links <- function(flows, node_order, node_groups) {
  flows <- flows |>
    filter(value > 0)

  used_names <- unique(c(flows$source_name, flows$target_name))

  nodes <- tibble(name = node_order) |>
    filter(name %in% used_names) |>
    mutate(group = unname(node_groups[name]))

  links <- flows |>
    mutate(
      source = match(source_name, nodes$name) - 1,
      target = match(target_name, nodes$name) - 1
    ) |>
    select(source, target, value, group)

  list(nodes = nodes, links = links)
}

sankey_tmp_dir <- file.path(out_tables, "sankey_tmp")
dir.create(sankey_tmp_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Reference-based status

```{r sankey_reference_status}
status_blast <- read.xlsx(data_path("tax_invasive.xlsx"), sheet = "taxonomy") |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  select(zotu_id, status_genus) |>
  mutate(
    zotu_id = tolower(zotu_id),
    status_blast = case_when(
      status_genus %in% c("native", "Native") ~ "Native",
      status_genus %in% c("introduced", "Introduced") ~ "Introduced",
      TRUE ~ "No information"
    ),
    status_blast = factor(status_blast, levels = c("Native", "Introduced", "No information"))
  ) |>
  select(zotu_id, status_blast)

blast_df <- sankey_taxonomy_df |>
  left_join(status_blast, by = "zotu_id") |>
  filter(!is.na(res_rank), !is.na(status_blast))

node_groups_blast <- c(
  "Species-level" = "rank_species",
  "Genus-level" = "rank_genus",
  "Family-level" = "rank_family",
  "Order-or-higher" = "rank_higher",
  "Native" = "status_native",
  "Introduced" = "status_introduced",
  "No information" = "status_unknown"
)

flows_blast <- blast_df |>
  count(res_rank, status_blast, name = "value") |>
  transmute(
    source_name = as.character(res_rank),
    target_name = as.character(status_blast),
    value = value,
    group = case_when(
      target_name == "Native" ~ "status_native",
      target_name == "Introduced" ~ "status_introduced",
      TRUE ~ "status_unknown"
    )
  )

blast_mats <- materialize_nodes_links(
  flows = flows_blast,
  node_order = c(rank_levels, "Native", "Introduced", "No information"),
  node_groups = node_groups_blast
)

colourJS_blast <- networkD3::JS("
  d3.scaleOrdinal()
    .domain(['rank_species','rank_genus','rank_family','rank_higher','status_native','status_introduced','status_unknown'])
    .range(['#2ca02c','#98df8a','#ff7f0e','brown','#33A02C','#B15928','#bdbdbd'])
")

sankey_blast <- sankeyNetwork(
  Links = blast_mats$links,
  Nodes = blast_mats$nodes,
  Source = "source",
  Target = "target",
  Value = "value",
  NodeID = "name",
  NodeGroup = "group",
  LinkGroup = "group",
  colourScale = colourJS_blast,
  fontSize = 44,
  nodeWidth = 34,
  sinksRight = TRUE,
  iterations = 0
)

sankey_blast <- htmlwidgets::onRender(
  sankey_blast,
  "function(el) { d3.select(el).selectAll('text').style('font-weight', '600'); }"
)

blast_html <- file.path(sankey_tmp_dir, "S3_sankey_blast.html")
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(widget = sankey_blast, file = blast_html, selfcontained = TRUE)
webshot2::webshot(
  url = blast_html,
  file = file.path(sankey_tmp_dir, "S3_sankey_blast.png"),
  vwidth = 1500,
  vheight = 700,
  zoom = 2
)
```

## NIClassify status

```{r sankey_niclassify_status}
status_ni <- read.csv(here::here("NIClassify/06_NIClassify_predict.csv")) |>
  janitor::clean_names() |>
  dplyr::rename(zotu_id = upid) |>
  filter(str_detect(zotu_id, "Zotu")) |>
  dplyr::select(zotu_id, status_ni = predict) |>
  mutate(zotu_id = tolower(zotu_id))

taxonomy_ni <- sankey_taxonomy_df |>
  left_join(status_ni, by = "zotu_id") |>
  mutate(
    status_ni = case_when(
      status_ni %in% c("native", "Native") ~ "Native",
      status_ni %in% c("introduced", "Introduced") ~ "Introduced",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    status_ni = factor(status_ni, levels = c("Native", "Introduced"))
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(res_rank), !is.na(status_ni))

node_groups_ni <- c(
  "Species-level" = "rank_species",
  "Genus-level" = "rank_genus",
  "Family-level" = "rank_family",
  "Order-or-higher" = "rank_higher",
  "Native" = "ni_native",
  "Introduced" = "ni_intro"
)

flows_ni <- taxonomy_ni |>
  count(res_rank, status_ni, name = "value") |>
  transmute(
    source_name = as.character(res_rank),
    target_name = as.character(status_ni),
    value = value,
    group = case_when(
      target_name == "Native" ~ "ni_native",
      TRUE ~ "ni_intro"
    )
  )

ni_mats <- materialize_nodes_links(
  flows = flows_ni,
  node_order = c(rank_levels, "Native", "Introduced"),
  node_groups = node_groups_ni
)

colourJS_ni <- networkD3::JS("
  d3.scaleOrdinal()
    .domain(['rank_species','rank_genus','rank_family','rank_higher','ni_native','ni_intro'])
    .range(['#2ca02c','#98df8a','#ff7f0e','brown','#1f78b4','#e31a1c'])
")

sankey_ni <- sankeyNetwork(
  Links = ni_mats$links,
  Nodes = ni_mats$nodes,
  Source = "source",
  Target = "target",
  Value = "value",
  NodeID = "name",
  NodeGroup = "group",
  LinkGroup = "group",
  colourScale = colourJS_ni,
  fontSize = 44,
  nodeWidth = 34,
  sinksRight = TRUE,
  iterations = 0
)

sankey_ni <- htmlwidgets::onRender(
  sankey_ni,
  "function(el) { d3.select(el).selectAll('text').style('font-weight', '600'); }"
)

ni_html <- file.path(sankey_tmp_dir, "S3_sankey_ni.html")
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(widget = sankey_ni, file = ni_html, selfcontained = TRUE)
webshot2::webshot(
  url = ni_html,
  file = file.path(sankey_tmp_dir, "S3_sankey_ni.png"),
  vwidth = 1500,
  vheight = 700,
  zoom = 2
)
```

## Assemble Figure 2

```{r sankey_figure}
library(cowplot)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
blast_in <- file.path(sankey_tmp_dir, "S3_sankey_blast.png")
ni_in <- file.path(sankey_tmp_dir, "S3_sankey_ni.png")

make_tagged_sankey_panel <- function(image_path, label) {
  ggdraw() +
    draw_image(image_path, x = 0, y = 0, width = 1, height = 0.92) +
    draw_label(
      label,
      x = 0.01,
      y = 0.99,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 11.5,
      fontface = "plain"
    )
}

p_blast <- make_tagged_sankey_panel(blast_in, "A)")
p_ni <- make_tagged_sankey_panel(ni_in, "B)")

combined <- plot_grid(
  p_blast, p_ni,
  ncol = 1,
  align = "v"
)

save_fig(
  tag = "F2_sankey_panel",
  plot = combined,
  which = "main",
  prefix = "none",
  width = 7.5,
  height = 7.6,
  dpi = 600
)
```
